Blog post about palliative care billing. Describes chronic care billing (PCM, TCM, CCM, PIN), time-based billing reports, CPT code recommendations.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. JS-rendered, limited content extractable. Will be reviewed in detail in Phase 2.
Hospice product page titled 'Patient Admissions'. JS-rendered, limited content visible.
PACE product page — 'Medicare PACE - Virtual Intake Platform (VIP)' for managing PACE enrollment/admissions digitally.
Accelerate CRM — fully integrated CRM for healthcare organizations, focused on hospice/palliative referral source management.
Feature spotlight on Accelerate CRM: built for nonprofit hospice sales process, account prioritization, connecting sales/referral/admissions.
About page. JS-rendered, limited content. Company tagline and social links visible.
Blog post 'Busting The Palliative Care Loss Leader Myth' (2018). Addresses financial viability of palliative care programs.
EHR archives/category page. JS-rendered, no article content extractable.
Axxess integration docs: SMARTMD integration sends patient demographics, admissions, discharges, deaths, diagnosis changes, and location updates between systems.
Capterra listing for SMARTMD. Categorized as Medical Transcription. Mentions dictation apps, transcription, billing & EHR integration. 403 on fetch but search snippet provided some info.
iOS App Store listing. Describes EHR integration, dictation, offline docs, document scanning, consent capture, charge capture, MIPS records, referral tracking.

LinkedIn profile: founded 1999, 201-500 employees (likely inflated), offices in WI/GA/FL. Specialties: transcription, dictation, billing, EHR scribe, referral mgmt, MACRA/MIPS, hospice, palliative, PACE.
CEO Nandip Kothari bio: CEO since 2008, MBA from Kellogg/Northwestern, prior roles at Tower Group, Interwoven, iManage, Motorola.
